rules.name: Repeated authentication failures
rules.summary: At least five authentication failures for the same account, host, and source IP occurred within ten minutes.
recommended_actions: Review the authentication timeline and confirm whether the source is expected.
Check for a successful login from the same source after the failures.

rules.name: Authentication failures followed by success
rules.summary: A successful authentication followed failures for the same account, host, and source IP within fifteen minutes.
recommended_actions: Validate the login with the account owner through an approved channel.
Review subsequent activity for the account and preserve relevant logs.

rules.name: Suspicious process behavior flagged by lab telemetry
rules.summary: Lab telemetry marked process behavior for analyst review.
recommended_actions: Review process ancestry, user context, and the related host timeline.
Do not isolate or stop a process until the alert is validated.

rules.name: Privileged group membership changed
rules.summary: A privileged group membership change was recorded in the lab telemetry.
recommended_actions: Confirm the change was approved and identify the initiating account.
Review nearby authentication and process events on the affected host.
